verdict.rationale: Windmill's docs list webhooks and HTTP routes as first-party triggers for scripts and flows, and say flows expose webhook endpoints, including version-pinned ones. That covers the core of an external HTTP request starting a workflow run. However, the evidence never shows how the request payload is passed into the run as inputs, or that the URL path can be custom-defined. missing for 10: documented mapping of the HTTP request payload into flow inputs, explicit evidence of custom/user-defined webhook URL paths, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload

citations.quote: Use schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more.
Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID instead of the latest deployment.
